title: mini silk flowers
text: mini silk flowers. First, look at the photo of these flowers.  Looks like a nice big pile of flowers - but you'd be mistaken.  Look at the photo I have provided.  Looking at the photo I knew they would not be 'daisys' as listed but I DID think there would be more than I could hold in the palm of my hand.  Super disappointed.  I would need to order about 5 more bags for this project and for the price, I certainly will not.  Shame on the seller for such a hugely deceptive photo.  I will not purchase again.
